reason: A bilingual DeepSeek Harness plugin for tracking model token usage and costs, managing budgets and pricing, displaying provider balances and quotas, and presenting related visual dashboards and alerts.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中统计模型调用费用与 Token 用量、管理预算和价格，并显示余额、额度、历史记录及相关提醒。
summaries.en: Tracks model-call costs and token usage in DeepSeek Harness while providing budget and pricing management, balance and quota displays, history, and related alerts.

capabilities: Aggregates model-call token usage and costs
Stores session, daily, monthly, and historical billing records locally
Queries official and configurable custom provider balance endpoints
Queries multiple provider subscription quota endpoints
Synchronizes pricing from official pricing pages
Displays in-app alerts and can request system notification permission
